Cangjie compiler and core standard library: official Cangjie 1.2.0 STS OHOS SDK.
Cangjie runtime source: https://gitcode.com/Cangjie/cangjie_runtime
Version: v1.2.0, commit 52f9e08f985ba42e23581e725e1b11f956f941d6.
Runtime rebuilt with HarmonyOS Release SDK 26.0.0.105 application NDK.
The application runtime uses the SDK libc++_shared.so ABI.
RULECORE_APP_RUNTIME excludes the ROM-only namespace probe; loading uses public dlopen/dlsym.
Runtime package version compatibility checks remain enabled (DISABLE_VERSION_CHECK=0).
Build-only securec source: OpenHarmony-v6.0-Release, commit 2ae82839ecaaa7d031e66ccbd2076d671acfd615.
Packaged libboundscheck.so remains from the official Cangjie SDK.
Upstream licenses and notices are preserved in this directory.
